invariants: Must preserve R-06.2 Event source model; do not add custom Event fields.
Use existing Event fields for actor goals, knowledge changes, opponent strategy, causal links, actions, costs and state deltas.
Do not treat decision intentions as guaranteed event outcomes.
No custom fields may be added to R-06.2 Event; map planned changes only into existing source-model fields.
P13C decision details and P13B asset-phase mappings remain separate immutable artifacts referenced through ARTIFACT_ENVELOPE.read_refs.
P13B expected_state_changes must each be mapped to an applicable Event field or explicitly reported as a blocking/conditional gap; silent omission is prohibited.
source_conflict_id/serves_conflict accept only real R-06.2 Conflict IDs, not P09/P10 relationship IDs or P13B cluster IDs.

source_field_mapping.BASE_LINE: variable_changes + state_at_start/state_at_end; use knowledge_changes, goal_changes, relation_changes, item_transfers where semantically applicable
source_field_mapping.DERIVED_LINE_PROPOSAL: retain the proposal in the P13B sidecar/Envelope; P16A creates the legal DERIVED line with cause=Event ID; use setup_payoff_links only for registered StoryAsset setup/payoff links
source_field_mapping.READER_COGNITION: causal_links retain the reveal obligation; cognitive_impact may summarize intended scene effect but is not an authoritative reader-information update; P15A maps the reveal to an authorized OutlineBeat payload and ReaderCognition derives from the approved outline.
source_field_mapping.WORLD_STATE: state_at_start/state_at_end + variable_changes; use rule_changes only for a proposed/approved rule state change through the WC revision contract

event_field_mapping.BASE_LINE: Event.variable_changes + Event.causal_links (target_ref and exact driver_refs retained)
event_field_mapping.DERIVED_LINE_PROPOSAL: Event.variable_changes as a proposed change + Event.causal_links; P16A later creates the DERIVED line after outline freeze
event_field_mapping.READER_COGNITION: causal_links only as a reveal obligation; cognitive_impact is descriptive only and must not assert reader knowledge; P15A maps the obligation to an authorized OutlineBeat payload, and ReaderCognition derives from the approved outline; never write it into participant knowledge_changes.
event_field_mapping.WORLD_STATE: Event.variable_changes only when target_ref resolves to a registered world-scope line; otherwise remain CONDITIONAL/UNRESOLVED

causal_link_provenance_requirements: Each link preserves the original driver_refs from the opportunity cluster.
Each link identifies target_kind, target_ref, change_intent and actual/planned result without adding top-level Event fields.
